blockers: The ratified scope (ZERO r1) still excludes content indexing while register r4 contracts a context engine; only the operator ratifies, so no session can build content without violating the method, and ZERO r2 has awaited ratification since 2026-10-23T14:09Z.
All capacity went into documentation and review: six handoffs, eleven minutes, seventeen messages, three substrate ADRs and two constitution drafts, but no database and no tested line of code.

Coordination changed three times in six weeks and each change restarts the reading (72% of the measured cost is re-reading fixed context), so the marginal cost of each session goes to orientation and not to delivery.
Decisions K1-K9 of the knowledge substrate were treated as a general blocker, although the bridge itself declares that the index core does not depend on them.

options.name: Close the scope first, then build
options.description: Ratify ZERO r2 and requirement-0003; write ADRs 0007-0009 of the engine; only then open the bridge and implement. Sequential and pure, but weeks without code.

options.name: Vertical slice now: segment 1 (local core) now, content layer in parallel
options.description: Authorize the already drafted bridge (inside the ratified r1 scope) and build it while ZERO r2 is ratified; then segment 2 (hash, extraction, search cascade, MCP bridge).

options.name: Context engine directly, without a metadata core
options.description: Skip the provider table and the incremental index; ingest a sample subset into the vector store and measure the cascade. Quick demonstration, but contradicts ZERO r1 and line 1 of r4 (incremental indexing is the base).

options.name: Cloud drive first (letter of the Project instruction)
options.description: Build the drive metadata adapter before any content. In scope, but depends on ADR-0002, OAuth and credentials, and proves no component of the engine.

criteria.text: Conformity with the ratified scope and with the method (nothing enters without requirement, ADR, bridge)
Time to the first useful query answered by the database (days)
How much of register r4 is proven by measurement
Low risk of new drift or rework (10 = minimum risk)
Cost in tokens and sessions to the first converge (10 = cheapest)
Independence from still-open operator decisions (K1-K9, OAuth, credentials)

loses_on: Segment 2 remains dependent on the ratification of ZERO r2.
Session cost is medium because two fronts run at the same time.

fronts.name: Front 0 - Governance and foundation (day 0, one session)

tasks.deliverable: One coordinator, one loop: the elected session writes the channel card and handoff seq 10 and closes the cards of ARC and cse_EXAMPLE_COORD1; the hourly :23 task stays as registrar; the "Coordinator 2" cycle and the reviewer's "LOOP handshake" are removed or suspended by the operator.
tasks.proof: One coordinator with an ACTIVE card and handoff seq 10 in the chain.

tasks.deliverable: Batch ratification RAT-0003: ZERO r2 + requirement-0003 + constitution r2 + authorization of the bridge mandate; /smard-agent-flow:analyze runs before the signature is requested.
Physical foundation: dedicated database instance with the required extensions and roles, private git repository with only construction and specs.
tasks.proof: Instance answers; extensions installable; repository created.
tasks.executor: Operator runs the setup commands; coordinator drafts setup.sql

tasks.deliverable: Project instruction corrected for delegation to cloud sessions and explicit acceptance of /smard-agent-flow:handoff.
tasks.proof: Project instruction no longer forbids delegation.

tasks.deliverable: Schema: provider, source, entry (source, native_id, generation), parent link, size_kind, jsonb extras; migrations 0001..n with down.
tasks.proof: pgTAP: two parents accepted; unknown size excluded from the total and counted; migration applies and reverts.

tasks.deliverable: Filesystem loader in Python + COPY, idempotent batches, cursor after commit, tombstones only in a subtree read in full, exclusions enforced by the database.
tasks.proof: pytest: same batch twice = same state; kill in the middle and restart loses nothing; collector DELETE fails.

tasks.deliverable: Rollup per published generation; generation switch in one transaction; advisory lock per source.
tasks.proof: pytest: totals equal the listing tool; reader never sees a partial load.

tasks.deliverable: Roles, row-level security per source, owner without login, default privileges.
tasks.proof: pgTAP: matrix profile x source x operation.

tasks.deliverable: Curation separated from facts, proposals by agents, optimistic version.
tasks.proof: pytest: sync never alters curation; concurrent edit raises a conflict.

tasks.deliverable: Full load of the sample tree measured on the dedicated instance.
tasks.proof: Time recorded; target PRF-001 below 10 s.
tasks.executor: Sonnet; measurement reported to the operator

fronts.name: Front 2 - Segment 2: content layer of the engine (week 2, after RAT-0003)

tasks.deliverable: Content hash per file and Merkle per folder in the incremental loader; only what changed is reprocessed (r4 line 1).
tasks.proof: pytest: changing one file reprocesses one; moving a folder does not reprocess content.

tasks.deliverable: Extraction and chunking: CLI extractor for prose/PDF, tree-sitter for code; chunk table with three text columns (original, normalized, lemmatized - the last filled later) (r4 lines 2, 3).
tasks.proof: pytest: 20 sample files -> chunks with reproducible offsets.

tasks.deliverable: Search cascade in SQL: exact -> trigram -> identifier-aware FTS -> vector embeddings -> reciprocal-rank fusion; strict empty-result contract (r4 lines 4, 5).
tasks.proof: bakeoff on sample questions: zero silent empty results; Recall@5 and MRR@10 recorded.

tasks.deliverable: Minimal MCP bridge over stdio: search, read_chunk, outline; authority taken from the database roles (r4 line 10).
tasks.proof: Two harnesses query the index; 5 real questions answered by the database.

tasks.deliverable: Measurement of candidate rerankers and of the embedding dimension; choice by measurement (r4 lines 11).
tasks.proof: HTML report with cited column headers (rule r-r1).

done_when.condition: RAT-0003 signed; instance answers; extensions installable; repository created; a single coordinator with an ACTIVE card and handoff seq 10 in the chain.
S1-01..S1-06 green on the dedicated instance; full load below 10 s; RLS matrix green; totals equal the listing tool.

bakeoff with the operator's questions without silent empty results; a harness queries the index through the MCP bridge and answers five real questions; reranker and dimension chosen by recorded measurement.
Goal of segment 3; declared only when the remaining lines of r4 are measured against the fixed benchmarks.

cost.statement: Quota used and week elapsed are not measurable from this session; before the first fan-out they are read from the spend ledger and the account panel and declared in the required form (quota X% used, Y% of the week, estimated cost Z USD). Prior estimate, to be confirmed: segment 1 with six Sonnet tasks of about 150 thousand tokens each and one 300 thousand token coordinator session is about 1.2 million tokens; segment 2, with embeddings and bakeoff, about 2 million.

risks: Write through the bridge with stale content: every write is checked by hash before use (rule r-c8-1).
Citations of other models: no version or license enters a record without a primary source (rule r-c9-1).
Scope drift: nothing of segment 2 starts before RAT-0003; if r2 is rejected, segment 1 proceeds alone and the plan is revised.
Non-commercial licenses: allowed in the pilot and marked as debt (rule r-c8-2).
